verdict.rationale: Claude Agent SDK is itself an agent-building framework (the agent/client role); its MCP evidence (docs-5, docs-25) is entirely about consuming/connecting to external MCP servers, not about exposing itself as an MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role carve-out, this axis does not apply unless the SDK ships an 'MCP server mode,' which is not evidenced here.
